r:
Display the core memory used per program (not per process)

In detail it reports:

sum (private RAM for program processes) +
sum (shared RAM for program processes)

The shared RAM is problematic to calculate, and the tool automatically selects the most accurate method available for the running kernel.

<dl><dt data-o="">-h --help</dt><dd>Show help message</dd><dt data-o="">-p PID[,PID2,...PIDN]</dt><dd>Show memory consumption for the specified processes</dd><dt data-o="">-s --split-args</dt><dd>Show and separate memory usage entries by command line arguments and not just the program name.</dd><dt data-o="">-t --total</dt><dd>Only display the total number of bytes for the selected processes</dd><dt data-o="">-w N</dt><dd>Report memory consumption every N seconds</dd></dl>
